note: Sample help articles written for the demo, to be replaced by TxDOT's own CRIS help content. They give general steps only and state no TxDOT policy.

articles.title: Cannot sign in
steps: Check the address of the sign-in page.
Reset your password from the sign-in page.
If the account is locked, say so in the ticket; support will unlock it.

articles.title: A crash report will not submit
steps: Check the fields marked as required.
Keep the report open; support can see where it stopped.

articles.title: Requesting a copy of a crash report
steps: Search by the crash identifier if you have it.
Say in the ticket which report you need and why.

articles.title: A report or query runs slowly or times out
steps: Narrow the date range and try again.
Note the time it happened; support checks it against monitoring.

articles.title: Correcting a submitted crash report
steps: Give the crash identifier and the field that is wrong.
Do not submit a second report for the same crash.

articles.title: Exporting data
steps: Say which data and which period you need.
Large exports are prepared by support and you are told when ready.

articles.title: Accessibility problems
steps: Say which page and which assistive tool you use.
Accessibility issues are treated as high priority.
